serverInfo.name: Dream Forge Web Tools
serverInfo.description: Browser-exposed tools for discovering Dream Forge capabilities and helping users begin photo-to-3D model workflows.

transport.description: Tools are registered in the browser with navigator.modelContext.registerTool() when the Dream Forge page loads.

tools.name: dreamforge.get_site_summary
tools.description: Return a concise summary of Dream Forge public capabilities and important URLs.

tools.name: dreamforge.start_creation
tools.description: Navigate the user to the localized 3D model creation flow.

tools.name: dreamforge.get_pricing_summary
tools.description: Return a high-level summary of free and premium generation capabilities.
